pages.text: Ultimate mob farms are compact, have no durability cost, and read drop tables directly—avoiding champion mob modifiers—making them ideal for passiving rarer drops.

Purple Blaze can be ultimate mob farmed and is a viable passive source for certain materials.$(br2)Passive farming of wildwood stars is best done with DML; alternatively, catch a rainbour and ultimate mob farm it, or craft using bloodgems from bloodgem chickens or the Deep Twilight Comb.
